programs.title: Kitchen skills to culinary jobs
programs.desc: Hands-on training in food safety, prep and line cooking. Graduates get a ServSafe certificate and interviews with partner restaurants.

programs.title: Resume and interview workshop
programs.desc: Volunteers help you write a resume, practice interviews and set up a job-search email. Bring an ID if you have one.

programs.title: Community dinner, all welcome
programs.desc: A hot sit-down dinner cooked by neighbors. Vegetarian and halal options every week.

programs.title: Food drive: pack 500 Kindboxes
programs.desc: Sort donated groceries and pack boxes for fridges across the city. Gloves and snacks provided. Ages 12+ with an adult.

programs.title: CalFresh and benefits sign-up help
programs.desc: One-on-one help applying for CalFresh food benefits, WIC and Medi-Cal. Bring ID and proof of income if you have it.

programs.title: Warehouse and forklift certification
programs.desc: OSHA-aligned forklift certification and warehouse safety. Job placement support with local employers after you finish.

programs.title: Digital skills for job seekers
programs.desc: Email, online job applications, video calls and basic spreadsheets. Go at your own pace with a tutor.

programs.title: Rental assistance clinic
programs.desc: Behind on rent? Meet caseworkers who can check eligibility for emergency rental help and tenant counseling.

programs.title: Free health screening and flu shots
programs.desc: Blood pressure, glucose and vision checks, plus flu shots. Nurses can connect you to a free clinic.

programs.title: Hunger Action Day: restock every fridge
programs.desc: A city-wide day to restock community fridges and shelves. Teams get a route, a cart and a list of what each fridge needs.

programs.title: Youth barista training
programs.desc: For ages 16 to 24. Learn espresso, customer service and cash handling, then a paid 6-week internship at a partner cafe.

programs.title: Senior lunch and social
programs.desc: A soft-food friendly lunch, tai chi and mahjong. Help with Medicare forms on Wednesdays.

programs.title: Veterans career fair
programs.desc: Meet 30+ employers hiring veterans. Free headshots, resume review and VA benefits help on site.

programs.title: Cooking well on a small budget
programs.desc: Cook three cheap, healthy meals from pantry staples. Every family takes home a bag of groceries.
